title: Format with the openmrs-tools formatter the code base uses
body:
On core-3.x, `spotless:check` failed with `Could not find artifact org.openmrs.tools:openmrs-tools:jar:3.0.0-SNAPSHOT`. The parent pom takes the formatter from openmrs-tools at `${openmrsPlatformVersion}`, and plugin SNAPSHOTs are disabled. Enabling them isn't enough: the 3.0 formatter differs from 2.8.0's and would rewrite every `catch` block in 52 files, so every master → core-3.x merge would conflict.

This pins `openmrsPlatformToolsVersion` to 2.8.0, the version master formats with, and runs `spotless:apply`. That reformats 19 files, all of them touched by #295, with line wrapping and whitespace only. `mvn spotless:check` passes locally on Java 21.

title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates emrapi so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Versions and build:
  - Module version is now 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT, on Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT (with `openmrs-bom` imported).
  - It uses metadatamapping 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT (`omod-common` + `omod` replace the per-version `omod-1.8`…`2.2` artifacts), legacyui, reporting and calculation 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and serialization.xstream 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
  - Builds with Java 21, `-parameters` and `-proc:full`. javac 23 and later no longer run Lombok from the classpath, and CI also builds on Java 25.
  - Removed: the event module (see below), javax servlet, geronimo javax.jms, codehaus Jackson, mockito-inline/byte-buddy, and the unused reportingcompatibility dependency.
  - joda-time is now `provided`, since core ships it.
  - CI uses JDK 21.
- DAOs: all Hibernate Criteria code in HibernateEmrConceptDAO, HibernateEmrEncounterDAO, HibernateEmrPatientDAO and HibernateSingleClassDAO is now HQL, with the same semantics. `org.hibernate.Query` becomes `org.hibernate.query.Query`.
- `EmrPatientService.findPatients` is removed, as EA-221 suggested. It has thrown since EA-219, and its only caller, coreapps' `FindPatientFragmentController`, isn't in the O3 distro.
- HQL resources:
  - `voided = 0` becomes `= false`.
  - `visits_awaiting_admission.hql` stops using `:list is null or x in :list`, which Hibernate 7 rejects.
  - `inpatient_requests.hql` uses `left join Obs … on …` instead of scalar entity subqueries.
- **The event module is gone.** It goes away for Platform 3 (openmrs/openmrs-module-event#33), so `ApplicationEventService.patientViewed` now publishes a `PatientViewedEvent` through core's `EventPublisher`. `PatientViewedEventListener` is a Spring listener that updates the last viewed patients in a daemon thread, with the token the activator hands it in `contextRefreshed()`. `ApplicationEventService` itself is unchanged for its callers (coreapps, registrationapp, radiologyapp), and the JMS topic constants are deprecated.
- **REST controllers map both `/rest/" + RestConstants.VERSION_1 + "/emrapi/...` and `/rest/emrapi/...`.** Spring 6+ rejects `/rest/**/emrapi/...`, which EA-194 introduced so that both forms work; pihcore and bahmniapps still call the unversioned one. A `/rest/*/emrapi/...` wildcard would be outranked by webservices.rest's own `/rest/v1/{resource}/{uuid}` mapping, so every emrapi endpoint would answer "Unknown resource".
- commons-lang becomes lang3, javax.persistence/servlet/jms become jakarta, and Jackson 1 becomes Jackson 2.
  - Visible changes, because Spring MVC ignored the codehaus annotations before:
    - `CustomJsonDateSerializer` now really applies to `EncounterTransaction` / `EncounterSearchParameters`, so their dates are strings like `2008-08-01T03:00:00.000+0300` instead of epoch milliseconds.
    - The `@JsonIgnore` on `getConceptUuid()` now applies, so observations and orders in `EncounterTransaction` JSON no longer include `conceptUuid`.
    - A concept's `units` is left out when it is null.
  - `EncounterSearchParameters` drops its two `@JsonDeserialize(using = CustomJsonDateDeserializer.class)` annotations instead of moving them, so request dates keep Jackson's default parsing (`EncounterSearchParametersTest`). That deserializer would drop the offset Bahmni sends and reject epoch milliseconds.
- `Daemon.runInDaemonThread` becomes `runInDaemonThreadWithoutResult`.
- metadatasharing stays optional (`aware_of`). It is kept off the test classpath, because its 1.9.0 context needs the removed `serializationServiceTarget`.
- Tests:
  - Migrated to JUnit 5.
  - The custom-representation size checks include `resourceVersion` (REST 3.1+).
  - `EmrApiRequestMappingTest` checks that every endpoint resolves to the same

title: (docs) Replace the dead Travis badge with the GitHub Actions one
body:
The README badge still points at travis-ci.org, which shut down and now redirects to a 404, so the badge renders blank. This module builds on GitHub Actions via build.yml, so this points the badge and its link there.

Heads up that the badge will show red right now: the latest build.yml run on master failed on 2026-09-03 on the OWASP dependency check job, not the Maven build.

title: EA-233: Create controller to return dose forms, dose form groups and routes of administration
body:
See: https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/EA-233 and [talk thread](https://talk.openmrs.org/t/proposal-for-linking-dosage-forms-to-routes-of-administration/49252).

Now that we have the relations mappings between dose form, dose form groups and routes of administration in CIEL, the PR implements a controller to return those relationships.

Tested by going to the route (`/openmrs/ws/rest/v1/emrapi/doseFormGroups`) and also by adding different representations (`?v=custom:(doseForms:(doseForm:ref,doseFormGroup:ref)`).

Note:
- I can't find a function in `ConceptService` to return a concept by reference term (`CIEL:123`) AND mapping type (`SAME-AS`), and had to make my own `getConceptBySameAsMapping()` function. Calling `ConceptService.getConceptByMapping(term)` fails because, for some dose form groups, we have multiple mappings for the same term ("SAME-AS" and "Route of administration")
- Other than the representation param (`?v=`), the controller takes no input. Not implemented, but we can technically speed up this controller via caching,
- We use "drug form" / "dose form" (and "drug form group" / "dose form group") somewhat interchangeably. I defaulted to "dose" throughout this PR, but don't have a strong preference.
